raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

- With an explicit `--hicache-size` or `--hicache-ratio`, every HiCache host pool checks itself against a fresh `psutil` sample of free host memory, divided by the number of local ranks (`host_memory_budget_bytes`).
- Ranks build and pin their pools at different times. A rank that checks after its peers pinned theirs is charged for their pools a second time and fails, even when the host has room.
- Whether a launch passes therefore depends on how the ranks interleave.
- Seen on Kimi-K3 TP8, one 3 TB MI355X host, `--hicache-size 240` with a 140 GB Mamba host pin (`--hicache-mamba-size-gb` in #47867) plus DSpark draft sidecars:

| Per rank | Host memory |
|---|---:|
| KV | 100 GB |
| Mamba | 140 GB |
| Draft | 74.08 GB |

- Seven ranks built their draft pools over 95 s; the eighth then failed while about 582 GB was still free:

```
ValueError: Not enough host memory available. Requesting 74.08 GB but only have 72.77 GB free.
```

- Auto-sizing (default ratio) does not have this problem: it samples once per rank before its all-reduce and books every pool against that snapshot with `host_memory_budget_scope`.

## Modifications

- `hicache_auto_size.py`: for an explicit size (resolution nulls `hicache_host_memory_fraction`), `auto_size_hicache` now:
  - takes one `host_memory_budget_bytes()` snapshot per rank,
  - waits on a world-group CPU barrier, so every rank samples before any allocates,
  - books the pools in `host_memory_budget_scope`.
  - Pool sizes do not change; a size that does not fit still fails, against the snapshot.
- `pool_host/base.py`: inside a scope the allowance is also capped by host memory free now (not divided by ranks), so pinned memory that books nothing (staging buffers, another engine) still counts.
- `memory_pool_host.py`: the DeepSeek V4 paged and state host pools pass their request to `host_memory_budget_bytes`, so they book it like the other host pools (outside a scope the argument has no effect).

| Sizing mode | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Auto (default ratio) | one snapshot, booked per pool | unchanged; V4 pools now also book |
| Explicit `--hicache-size` / `--hicache-ratio` | fresh sample per pool, / ranks per host | one snapshot after a barrier, booked per pool, capped by free-now |

- Related PRs: #47867 (`--hicache-mamba-size-gb`) needs an explicit `--hicache-size`, so its pinned Mamba pool goes through this path; #47040 does not interact with it.

## Accuracy Tests

- No model output changes: only the host-memory admission check moves.
- `test_hicache_auto_size.py` (CPU):

| Test | Guards | Before fix |
|---|---|---|
| `test_explicit_size_books_a_snapshot_taken_before_peers_allocate` | 4 ranks/host, 3 peers pin after the snapshot; pool booked against the snapshot | fails with the error above |
| `test_explicit_size_samples_host_memory_before_the_rank_barrier` | snapshot precedes the world-group barrier | fails (no barrier) |
| `test_deepseek_v4_host_pools_book_the_snapshot` | both V4 host pools reduce the remaining budget | fails |
| `test_snapshot_budget_never_exceeds_host_memory_free_now` | free-now cap | fails |

| Suite (MI355X) | Result |
|---|---|
| auto-size, `test_mem_pool_host`, host-register, DSv4 HiCache L2, staged write-back, page-unified staging, MiniMax M3.1 transfer, MiniMax sparse PD | 132 passed, 1 skipped |
| After merging current `main`: auto-size, host-memory, pool_host/, assembler, DSv4 L2, MiniMax, page-unified suites | 157 passed |

- Not run end to end: the Kimi-K3 launch needs the whole 8-GPU host. With the fix each rank there books 314 GB against a snapshot share of about 389 GB.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

- Not applicable: one CPU barrier runs once at startup, where auto-sizing already runs an all-reduce.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

     return total + sum(_draft_bytes(pool, draft) for draft in drafts)
 
 
+@contextmanager
+def _explicit_size_budget():
+    """Book explicitly sized host pools against a snapshot taken before any rank
+    allocates; re-sampling per pool charges a late rank for its peers' pools."""
+    budget = host_memory_budget_bytes()
+    if torch.distributed.is_initialized():
+        torch.distributed.barrier(group=get_parallel().world_group.cpu_group)
+    with host_memory_budget_scope(budget):
+        yield

         )
 
+    def test_explicit_size_books_a_snapshot_taken_before_peers_allocate(self):
+        """An explicit --hicache-size is checked against host memory sampled
+        before any rank allocates, not after its peers pinned their pools."""
+        pool = MHATokenToKVPool(
+            size=128,
+            page_size=2,
+            dtype=torch.float16,
+            head_num=2,
+            head_dim=4,
+            layer_num=2,
+            device="cpu",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+        )
+        # 1e-5 GB is 79 pages of 2 tokens at 64 bytes per token on every rank.
+        pool_bytes = 79 * 2 * 64
+        rank_budget = 12_000
+        host_free = {"bytes": base.HICACHE_HOST_MEMORY_RESERVE_BYTES + 4 * rank_budget}
+        with (
+            get_context().override_server_args(
+                enable_hierarchical_cache=True, hicache_host_memory_fraction=None
+            ),
+            patch.object(base, "ranks_per_host", return_value=4),
+            patch.object(
+                base,
+                "available_host_memory_bytes",
+                side_effect=lambda **_: host_free["bytes"],
+            ),
+            sizing.auto_size_hicache(None, None, enabled=True),
+        ):
+            # Three peers on this host pin their pools before this rank builds its own.
+            host_free["bytes"] -= 3 * pool_bytes
+            host = MHATokenToKVPoolHost(
+                pool.get_device_pool_infos()[0].buffer_info,
+                2.0,
+                1e-5,
+                2,
+                "layer_first",
+                pin_memory=False,
+                device="cpu",
+                device_capacity_tokens=pool.size,
+                start_layer=pool.start_layer,
+                end_layer=pool.end_layer,
+                write_back_staging=pool.hicache_write_back_staging,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(host.size * host.size_per_token, pool_bytes)
+            self.assertEqual(base.host_memory_budget_bytes(), rank_budget - pool_bytes)
+        self.assertIsNone(base._host_memory_budget.get())
+
+    def test_explicit_size_samples_host_memory_before_the_rank_barrier(self):
+        calls = Mock()
+        calls.free.return_value = base.HICACHE_HOST_MEMORY_RESERVE_BYTES + 1000
+        with (
+            get_context().override_server_args(
+                enable_hierarchical_cache=True, hicache_host_memory_fraction=None
+            ),
+            patch.object(base, "ranks_per_host", return_value=1),
+            patch.object(base, "available_host_memory_bytes", calls.free),
+            patch.object(torch.distributed, "is_initialized", return_value=True),
+            patch.object(torch.distributed, "barrier", calls.barrier),
+            patch.object(
+                sizing,
+                "get_parallel",
+                return_value=SimpleNamespace(
+                    world_group=SimpleNamespace(cpu_group="cpu")
+                ),
+            ),
+            sizing.auto_size_hicache(None, None, enabled=True),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(base.host_memory_budget_bytes(), 1000)
+        names = [name for name, _, _ in calls.mock_calls]
+        self.assertEqual(names[:2], ["free", "barrier"])
+        calls.barrier.assert_called_once_with(group="cpu")
+
+    def test_deepseek_v4_host_pools_book_the_snapshot(self):
+        alloc = Mock(return_value=torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.uint8))
+        state_infos = [
+            DSV4StateBufferInfo(
+                pages=torch.empty((4, 3), dtype=torch.uint8),
+                ring_size=2,
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+            )
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+        with (
+            patch.dict(ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS, {"cpu": alloc}),
+            base.host_memory_budget_scope(1000),
+        ):
+            # 3 layers x 4 pages x 11 bytes
+            DeepSeekV4PagedHostPool(
+                pool_name="kv",
+                device_buffers=[torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.uint8) for _ in range(3)],
+                item_bytes=11,
+                num_host_pages=4,
+                slot_page_size=2,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(base.host_memory_budget_bytes(), 1000 - 132)
+            state = DeepSeekV4StateHostPool(
+                pool_name="state",
+                state_infos=state_infos,
+                num_host_pages=4,
+                swa_page_size=2,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(
+                base.host_memory_budget_bytes(),
+                1000 - 132 - state.layer_num * 4 * state.state_page_bytes,
+            )
+
+    def test_snapshot_budget_never_exceeds_host_memory_free_now(self):
+        """Pinned memory that books nothing (staging buffers, another engine)
+        still caps the allowance."""
+        free_now = base.HICACHE_HOST_MEMORY_RESERVE_BYTES + 300
+        with (
+            patch.object(base, "available_host_memory_bytes", return_value=free_now),
+            base.host_memory_budget_scope(1000),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(base.host_memory_budget_bytes(500), 300)
+            self.assertEqual(base.host_memory_budget_bytes(200), 300)
+            self.assertEqual(base._host_memory_budget.get(), 800)
